title: Fix Playground Chrome Subscribe Binding
description: Fix TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'chromeListeners') at subscribeChrome when PlaygroundView uses useSyncExternalStore with unbound runtime.subscribeChrome.
summary: Fixed PlaygroundView crash: useSyncExternalStore was passed unbound `runtime.subscribe` and `runtime.subscribeChrome`, so `this` was undefined inside Platform methods. Wrapped both in arrow functions so listeners register on the correct Platform instance.
